page_title: LEN 0-1 LYO | Lens v Lyon 16/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by Adam Karabec (Lyon). Romain Lissorgue doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+2' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) replaces Malick Fofana.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Georges Mikautadze, who is replaced by Adam Karabec (Lyon).
90+1' Florian Thauvin (Lens) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Florian Thauvin (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Dangerous play by Samson Baidoo (Lens). Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lyon.
86' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
86' Substitution. Florian Sotoca (Lens) on for Wesley Said.
85' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Ruben Aguilar is replaced by Saud Abdulhamid (Lens).
83' Flag goes up against Ruben Aguilar (Lens) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' The game is interrupted. Samson Baidoo (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
81' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends the corner into the box, but Remy Descamps intercepts it and averts the threat.
80' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
79' A pass from Wesley Said (Lens) is intercepted by Remy Descamps and the move breaks down.

78' Golden opportunity! Andy Diouf (Lens) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Anthony Bermont (Lens) coming on for Deiver Machado.
75' Surely that's handball by one of the Lyon players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
72' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
71' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
69' A pass from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is intercepted by Robin Risser and the move breaks down.
69' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
66' Here comes a substitution. Sael Kumbedi is given a rest as he is replaced by Khalis Merah (Lyon).
66' Wesley Said (Lens) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
64' Florian Thauvin (Lens) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
64' Florian Thauvin (Lens) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
63' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lens force their opponents to concede a corner.
63' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
62' Matthieu Udol (Lens) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Abner Vinicius (Lyon), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
60' Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul after Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Lens.
59' Wesley Said (Lens) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
57' Substitution. Rayan Fofana did his best and is replaced by Florian Thauvin (Lens).

57' A precise low pass is received by Deiver Machado (Lens), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
57' Andy Diouf (Lens) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

56' Andy Diouf (Lens) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the top right corner, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
56' Romain Lissorgue shows the yellow card to Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) for a heavy challenge.
55' Romain Lissorgue couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tyler Morton (Lyon) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Lens, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

54' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
54' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
53' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
53' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
52' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
51' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
51' The resulting corner from Tyler Morton (Lyon) is cleared.
50' An attempted cross from Malick Fofana (Lyon) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
48' The foul by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) was seen by Romain Lissorgue who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Lens will take a free kick near the side line.

48' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
47' Andy Diouf (Lens) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.

46' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle after Abner Vinicius (Lyon) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lens win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+4' Deiver Machado (Lens) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Remy Descamps is alert and denies him with a nice save. Lens have a corner.
45+2' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lens have been awarded a free kick.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Malick Fofana sets up Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Deiver Machado (Lens) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
42' Romain Lissorgue shows a yellow card to Malang Sarr (Lens) for a tough tackle.
42' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

41' Remy Descamps pulls off a great save to deny Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.

41' A sweet pass inside the box gives Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
40' Lens work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
39' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
37' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Tyler Morton (Lyon) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
35' Malick Fofana (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Samson Baidoo (Lens) sees a yellow card from Romain Lissorgue after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
33' Tyler Morton (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
33' A player from Lens commits a rough challenge. Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Lyon earn a free kick.
32' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

32' Malick Fofana (Lyon) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
30' Matthieu Udol (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Lens get a corner.
30' Deiver Machado (Lens) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
30' The game is interrupted now, Deiver Machado (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Deiver Machado (Lens) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon are awarded a free kick.
27' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) is penalised for a foul. Romain Lissorgue had a clear view and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Lyon in a dangerous position.
26' Lens are ruled offside.
25' Rayan Fofana (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
24' Samson Baidoo (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared.
23' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Lens earn a corner.
22' One of the players from Lens times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

21' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Deiver Machado (Lens), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
20' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Remy Descamps intercepts the ball.
18' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
17' Tyler Morton (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
17' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Malick Fofana (Lyon). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.
15' A cross by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
14' Tyler Morton (Lyon) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

14' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Robin Risser makes a great save to stop his effort. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
14' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

13' What a huge chance for Georges Mikautadze (Lyon). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
12' Clinton Mata (Lyon) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
11' Tyler Morton (Lyon) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

11' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
10' Rough tackle by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lens have a free kick.
9' Rayan Fofana (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
8' Wesley Said (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lyon, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' A pass lands at the feet of Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
5' Wesley Said (Lens) strikes the ball towards goal from the free kick on the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper makes a good save.
4' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul. Lens are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Adrien Thomasson (Lens), but it's just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
3' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
3' Rayan Fofana (Lens) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lens.
2' Rayan Fofana (Lens) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue is introduced as the referee for today's match.
